newsitem.title: USA: Chesapeake Energy sets two-for-one split.
newsitem.headline: Chesapeake Energy sets two-for-one split.

text.p: Chesapeake Energy Corp said on Tuesday its board of directors declared a two-for-one stock split.
This split is subject to a shareholder vote at the annual meeting on December 13, 1996, which would provide sufficient authorized shares to fund the stock split, the company said.

If approved, the stock split will be effected in the form of a dividend, with one additional share of the company's common stock to be distributed for every share held on the record date, the company said.
The additional shares will be mailed December 31, 1996 to shareholders of record on December 13, the company said.
Chesapeake Energy currently has approximately 34.6 million shares outstanding and will have approximately 69.2 million after the stock dividend.
